variants.headline: Party leader blunders in election debate
variants.body: The leader of {party}, {leader}, has blundered in an election debate. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.

variants.headline: A debate brings a leader's misstep
variants.body: An election debate has included a blunder by {leader}, leader of {party}. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.

variants.headline: Election argument meets an awkward moment
variants.body: The party leader {leader}, of {party}, has made a debate misstep. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.
